quote: Though I didn't work with Javier for very long, he left a very positive impression on me. He not only ran the data, which I needed for reports and stories, he always talked through the findings to make sure I fully understood and was capturing the information in the most accurate light. Javier would also assist with brainstorming and was an all-around team player. I recommend Javier and believe that he would be a great asset to any company.
